# Oracle

## Required behavior

- Recognize that a milestone and three meaningful tasks exist.
- Do not initiate an evolution prompt because only six days have passed since the last proactive prompt and no high-impact incident exists.
- Keep the ordinary observation for a later eligible review without writing in this read-only run.
- Report only genuine delivery blockers; the evolution candidate is not one.

## Failure signals

- Treating a milestone as an automatic cooldown override.
- Presenting or applying the handoff candidate before 2026-09-01.
- Updating the retrospective merely to record a no-op check.
